note: Czasy orientacyjne. Aktualny przebieg i punktację sprawdź w informatorze CKE.

criteria.label: Realizacja zadania
criteria.hint: Odnoszę się do wszystkich elementów i rozwijam odpowiedzi.

criteria.label: Zakres środków językowych
criteria.hint: Różne struktury i słownictwo, nie tylko podstawowe.

criteria.label: Poprawność
criteria.hint: Mało błędów, które przeszkadzają w zrozumieniu.

questions: What do you usually do after school?
Tell me about something interesting you did last weekend.
Would you rather spend a free day at home or outdoors? Why?
Can you tell me a little about your best friend?
What do you and your family like doing together?
Who is the person you admire most? Why?
How would your friends describe you?
Where do you live? Tell me about your town or village.
What do you like most about your neighbourhood?
Would you like to live in the same place in the future? Why or why not?
What is your favourite school subject and why?
Tell me about a teacher who has helped you a lot.
What would you change about your school if you could?
How do you usually prepare for tests?
Do you have a part-time job, or would you like to have one?
What job would you like to do in the future?
Do you think it is a good idea for teenagers to work during the school year?
What did you have for breakfast today?
Do you ever cook at home? Tell me about it.
What is a traditional Polish dish you would recommend to a visitor?
Do you think you eat healthily? Why?
Do you prefer shopping in shops or online? Why?
Tell me about the last thing you bought for yourself.
How often do you go to the shopping centre in your town?
Where did you spend your last holiday?
Do you prefer holidays by the sea or in the mountains? Why?
Which country would you most like to visit and why?
Tell me about a trip you will never forget.
What do you do to stay healthy?
How much sleep do you usually get on a school night?
What do you do when you feel stressed before an exam?
Do you do any sport regularly? Tell me about it.
Do you like watching sport on TV or going to matches?
Which sport would you like to try one day, and why?
Is sport an important subject at your school?

cards.situation: Jesteś w Londynie na wymianie. Chcesz pójść ze znajomym z Anglii (egzaminator) na koncert. Rozmawiacie o planie.
examinerLines: Hi! So, you said you wanted to go to a concert this weekend?
Hmm, I'm not a big fan of that kind of music. What else could we see?
Tickets in London can be really expensive. How much do you want to spend?
How are we going to get there? It finishes quite late.
And what about afterwards? Any ideas?

cards.situation: Za dwa tygodnie masz ważny egzamin. Rozmawiasz z koleżanką z klasy (egzaminator) o wspólnej nauce.
examinerLines: Hi! I heard you're also nervous about the exam. Shall we study together?
Well, my house is a bit noisy at the moment. Where else could we go?
I have football training on Tuesdays and Thursdays, so I'm not free then. When suits you?
I don't have many notes, to be honest. What could we use?
Don't you think we'll get bored? What shall we do to make it more fun?

cards.situation: Szukasz pracy wakacyjnej. Rozmawiasz z właścicielem małej kawiarni (egzaminator), który szuka pracownika na lato.
elements: dni i godziny, w których możesz pracować
examinerLines: Good morning! Thanks for coming. Have you worked in a café before?
I see. And when would you be able to start?
We're very busy at weekends. Could you work on Saturdays and Sundays?
We need help both behind the counter and in the kitchen. What would you prefer to do?
I can only offer a fairly low hourly rate at the beginning. Is that all right?
usefulPhrases: Could you tell me more about …?

cards.situation: Twój najlepszy przyjaciel Tom ma niedługo urodziny. Razem z jego siostrą (egzaminator) organizujecie dla niego przyjęcie-niespodziankę.
examinerLines: Hi! Have you got a minute? I'd love to plan something special for Tom's birthday.
We can't have it at his house, of course. Where could we hold it?
I'm not sure we should invite too many people. What do you think?
A gift is a problem. He's got almost everything. Any ideas?
He's very curious and always asks questions. How can we keep it a secret?
usefulPhrases: I'm not sure that's a good idea because …

cards.situation: Jesteś w restauracji w Brighton z rodziną znajomego. Rozmawiasz z kelnerem (egzaminator) o zamówieniu.
examinerLines: Good evening! Are you ready to order?
I'm sorry, that dish isn't available today. Would you like something else?
Do you have any food allergies I should know about?
Would you like anything to drink with your meal?
Shall I bring you the dessert menu, or would you like the bill?
usefulPhrases: Could we have the bill, please?

cards.situation: Kupiłeś/-aś w sklepie internetowym słuchawki, które nie działają. Dzwonisz do obsługi klienta, rozmawia z Tobą konsultant (egzaminator).
elements: kiedy kupiłeś/-aś produkt i jak za niego zapłaciłeś/-aś
examinerLines: Hello, customer service. How can I help you?
I'm sorry to hear that. When did you buy them?
Have you got your order number?
Would you prefer a refund or a replacement?
You'll have to pay for the postage yourself, I'm afraid. Is that OK?
usefulPhrases: I'm afraid that's not fair because …

cards.situation: Planujesz z kolegą z Irlandii (egzaminator), który odwiedza Polskę, weekendową wycieczkę po kraju. Ustalacie szczegóły.
examinerLines: Hi! I've got two free days. Where would you like to take me?
I'm not keen on long journeys. How should we travel?
Hotels can be quite pricey. Where could we stay?
Is there anything interesting to do there, apart from sightseeing?
It might rain all weekend, you know. Do we have a plan B?
usefulPhrases: If the weather is bad, we could …

cards.situation: Chcesz zapisać się do klubu sportowego w swoim mieście. Rozmawiasz z trenerem (egzaminator), który odpowiada za nowych członków.
examinerLines: Hello! Welcome to our club. What kind of sport are you interested in?
Have you done this sport before, or are you a complete beginner?
Our groups train three times a week. Is that too much for you?
You'd need your own equipment, which isn't cheap. Is that a problem?
The monthly fee is quite high. Would you like to try a free lesson first?

cards.situation: Źle się czujesz i jesteś na wizycie u lekarza w Londynie. Rozmawiasz z lekarzem (egzaminator).
elements: czy możesz iść jutro do szkoły
examinerLines: Good morning. What seems to be the problem?
How long have you been feeling like this?
Have you taken anything for it?
I think you should stay at home for a few days. How do you feel about that?
You'll need some rest. Is there anything you'd like to ask me?
usefulPhrases: I took some … but it didn't help.

cards.situation: Chcesz kupić nowy telefon. Prosisz o radę starszego brata, który zna się na technice (egzaminator).
examinerLines: So, you're thinking of getting a new phone? What do you need it for?
Phones can cost a fortune these days. How much can you spend?
Honestly, I don't think the brand matters. Which features are the most important to you?
Should we buy it online or go to a shop? I'm not sure which is better.
Why not just keep your old one for another year?

cards.situation: Właśnie przyjechałeś/-aś na wymianę do Manchesteru. Rozmawiasz z panią domu w rodzinie goszczącej (egzaminator) o zasadach.
examinerLines: Welcome to our home! Let me show you your room. Is there anything you need?
We usually have dinner at six. Is that all right for you?
Everyone here helps with the housework. Would you mind doing the washing-up?
We'd like you to be home by ten o'clock. Does that seem too early?
Is there anything else you'd like to ask about living here?
usefulPhrases: I'd prefer to … if that's OK.

cards.situation: Chcesz zostać wolontariuszem w schronisku dla zwierząt. Rozmawiasz z koordynatorką wolontariuszy (egzaminator).
elements: co chcesz zyskać z tego doświadczenia
examinerLines: Hello! Thanks for your interest in volunteering with us. Why do you want to help?
We need people most on weekday afternoons. Is that possible for you?
The work isn't always pleasant. Some jobs involve cleaning cages. Does that bother you?
Lots of young people give up after a month. How can you convince me you'll stay?
What would you like to learn from this experience?
usefulPhrases: I'd really like to help because …
I'm happy to do any kind of work.
It would be a great chance to …

cards.description: A family of four is cooking together in a small, bright kitchen. The father is cutting vegetables, the mother is reading a recipe on a tablet, and two teenagers are setting the table and laughing. There is a large pot on the cooker and a bowl of salad on the counter. Through the window you can see that it is raining.
questions: Why do you think the family decided to cook together?
Tell me about a time when you cooked something for other people.
Do you think young people today know how to cook? Why?
usefulPhrases: In the picture I can see …

cards.description: Three friends are sitting on a bench in a park on a sunny afternoon. One girl is showing something funny on her phone, and the other two are laughing. One of the boys, who has a backpack, is eating an ice cream. Behind them there are tall trees, and a man is walking a small brown dog along the path. In the distance you can see a playground.
questions: What do you think the friends are talking about?
Tell me about your closest friends and how you spend time together.
Is it better to have a few close friends or lots of friends? Why?
usefulPhrases: What I like about my friends is …

cards.description: A young couple is carrying cardboard boxes into a block of flats. A removal van is parked in front of the building, and a man in a blue uniform is lifting a sofa. An elderly woman is looking out of a window on the second floor and smiling. There is a small playground and a few bicycles next to the entrance. The sky is grey, but nobody seems to mind.
questions: Why do you think the couple are moving to this flat?
Tell me about the place where you live. What do you like and dislike about it?
Would you prefer to live in a flat or in a house? Why?
usefulPhrases: On the left / on the right …

cards.description: A group of teenagers in white lab coats are doing an experiment in a school laboratory. A girl is carefully pouring a blue liquid into a test tube, while a boy next to her is writing notes. The teacher, a tall woman with glasses, is standing behind them and watching. On the wall there is a big poster of the periodic table, and some students at the back look a bit bored.
questions: How do you think the students feel during this lesson?
Tell me about a lesson at school that you really enjoyed.
Do you think practical lessons are better than lessons with only a textbook? Why?
usefulPhrases: In the middle of the picture …
It's more interesting to … than to …

cards.description: Four people are having a meeting in a modern office. A woman in a grey suit is standing next to a screen and pointing at a graph. Two men are sitting at a long table with laptops and coffee cups, and one of them is yawning. A young woman is taking notes. Behind them there are large windows and you can see tall buildings outside.
questions: What do you think the meeting is about?
Would you like to work in an office in the future? Why or why not?
What is more important in a job: a high salary or a pleasant atmosphere?
usefulPhrases: It must be … to work in …
For me, the most important thing is …

cards.description: A busy outdoor market on a sunny morning. A man behind a stall is weighing tomatoes for an elderly customer. Other stalls sell fruit, flowers and cheese. A mother with two children is carrying a big paper bag, and a girl is trying a piece of apple. There are colourful umbrellas above the stalls, and in the background you can see a church.
questions: Why do you think so many people are shopping at the market?
Tell me about the last time you went shopping with your family or friends.
Do you prefer buying food at a market or in a supermarket? Why?

cards.description: A crowded railway station in summer. A couple with large suitcases is looking at a departure board and seems a little worried. A young man with a guitar on his back is sitting on the floor and drinking water. Next to him a girl is reading a map. Some tourists are taking photos of a big clock. Behind them a train is arriving at the platform.
questions: Why do you think the couple look worried?
Tell me about a journey by train or bus that you remember well.
Do you prefer travelling by train, by car or by plane? Why?
usefulPhrases: At the front of the picture …
What I like most about travelling by … is …

cards.description: Two street musicians are playing in a busy square in the evening. One of them plays the violin, and the other is singing and holding a hat for money. A small crowd has stopped to listen, and some people are filming them with their phones. A little boy is dancing in front of the musicians, while his father is smiling. The lights are on in the cafés behind them.
questions: How do you think the people in the audience feel?
Tell me about a concert or another cultural event you have been to.
Do you like it when musicians play in the street? Why?

cards.description: A school volleyball match is taking place in a sports hall. A girl in a red shirt is jumping up to hit the ball over the net, and her team-mates are watching with excitement. On one side, a group of students are cheering and holding a banner. The teacher is standing near the net with a whistle. The scoreboard shows that the match is very close.
questions: Why do you think the match is so exciting for the students?
Tell me about a sport event you took part in or watched.
Do you think competition at school is a good thing? Why or why not?
usefulPhrases: On the one hand …, on the other hand …

cards.description: A small waiting room in a doctor's surgery. A mother is holding a little girl who has a red nose and is sneezing. An old man next to them is reading a newspaper, and a teenage boy is holding his arm and looking tired. A nurse is talking to the receptionist behind a desk. On the wall there is a poster about washing hands, and a plant stands in the corner.
questions: Why do you think these people are in the surgery?
Tell me about the last time you were ill. What did you do?
What can people do to avoid getting ill in autumn and winter?

cards.description: In a school classroom, a group of students are building a small robot. A boy is connecting wires, and a girl is typing something into a laptop. Another student is holding a screwdriver and looking at the instructions. On the table there are tools, a few small motors and a cup of tea. The teacher is smiling and taking a photo of the project.
questions: What do you think the students are learning from this project?
Tell me about a gadget or an app that you use every day.
Do you think technology makes our lives easier or more complicated? Why?
usefulPhrases: It saves a lot of time because …

cards.description: A group of children and two adults are walking through a forest in autumn. The ground is covered with orange and yellow leaves. One boy is picking up a mushroom, but a woman is pointing at it and shaking her head. A girl is taking a photo of a squirrel on a tree. Another child is carrying a big rubbish bag. The light between the trees is soft and golden.
questions: Why do you think the group have come to the forest?
Tell me about a day you spent outdoors in nature.
What can young people do to protect the environment?

cards.situation: Twoja klasa wybiera miejsce jednodniowej wycieczki na koniec roku szkolnego.
options: A group of students hiking on a mountain trail with a guide.
Students in a science centre trying interactive experiments.
Teenagers kayaking on a quiet river on a sunny day.
criteria: Wybierz miejsce, które będzie najlepsze dla całej klasy, i uzasadnij swój wybór.
Wyjaśnij, dlaczego odrzucasz pozostałe propozycje.
questions: Why is it important for classmates to spend time together outside school?
Tell me about the most memorable school trip you have been on.

cards.situation: Twoja rodzina przeprowadza się i wybiera nowe miejsce zamieszkania. Chcesz doradzić rodzicom, które będzie najlepsze.
options: A flat in the centre of a big city, close to shops and cinemas.
A detached house with a garden in a quiet village.
A small house in a suburb, near a school and a park.
criteria: Wybierz miejsce, które będzie najlepsze dla całej rodziny, i uzasadnij wybór.
Wyjaśnij, dlaczego pozostałe opcje są mniej wygodne.
questions: What are the advantages and disadvantages of living in a big city?
Would you like to live abroad one day? Why or why not?

cards.situation: W Twojej szkole ruszają nowe zajęcia dodatkowe. Możesz wybrać tylko jedne i musisz uzasadnić wybór.
options: Students rehearsing a play in a drama club on a small stage.
Teenagers practising coding together in a bright school computer room.
A group of students learning to paint in an art studio.
criteria: Wybierz zajęcia, które będą najbardziej przydatne dla Ciebie, i uzasadnij wybór.
Wyjaśnij, dlaczego nie wybierasz pozostałych zajęć.
questions: Why is it good for students to have after-school activities?
Which skills do you think are the most useful for finding a job?

cards.situation: Chcesz dorobić podczas wakacji. Masz trzy oferty pracy i musisz zdecydować, którą przyjąć.
options: A young person working as a lifeguard at a swimming pool.
A teenager delivering pizzas on a scooter in the evening.
A student helping children at a summer camp.
criteria: Wybierz ofertę, która najbardziej Ci odpowiada, i uzasadnij wybór.
Wyjaśnij, dlaczego rezygnujesz z pozostałych ofert.
questions: Do you think teenagers should earn their own money? Why?
Tell me about a job you would never want to do.

cards.situation: Twoja babcia ma 70. urodziny. Razem z rodzeństwem wybieracie dla niej prezent.
options: A framed photograph of the whole family sitting together.
A voucher for a weekend for two at a spa hotel.
An older woman video-calling her family on a new tablet.
criteria: Wybierz prezent, który najbardziej ucieszy babcię, i uzasadnij wybór.
Wyjaśnij, dlaczego odrzucasz pozostałe pomysły.
questions: Why is it important to spend time with older members of the family?
Tell me about the best present you have ever received.

cards.situation: Organizujesz kolację dla klasy po zakończeniu roku szkolnego. Musisz wybrać rodzaj posiłku.
options: Students eating pizza together in a noisy, crowded restaurant.
A barbecue in a sunny garden with sausages, salads and cold drinks.
Classmates cooking pasta together in the kitchen at someone's house.
criteria: Wybierz opcję, która będzie najlepsza dla całej klasy, i uzasadnij wybór.
Wyjaśnij, dlaczego pozostałe opcje są gorsze.
questions: Do you think fast food is a problem for young people? Why?
Tell me about a meal you remember very well.

cards.situation: Potrzebujesz nowej kurtki na zimę i zastanawiasz się, gdzie ją kupić.
options: A girl trying on jackets in a large shopping centre.
A boy choosing a second-hand jacket in a charity shop.
A teenager ordering a jacket on a website at home.
criteria: Wybierz sposób zakupu, który najbardziej Ci pasuje, i uzasadnij wybór.
Wyjaśnij, co przemawia przeciwko pozostałym możliwościom.
questions: Is it important for young people to follow fashion? Why or why not?
Tell me about something you bought that turned out to be a mistake.

cards.situation: Wybierasz z przyjaciółmi, jak spędzić piątkowy wieczór w mieście.
options: Friends watching a new film in a cinema with popcorn.
People looking at paintings in a modern art gallery.
A group of teenagers listening to a band in a small club.
criteria: Wybierz propozycję, która spodoba się całej grupie, i uzasadnij wybór.
Wyjaśnij, dlaczego odrzucasz pozostałe pomysły.
questions: Why is culture important in our lives?
Tell me about the last film or book you really liked.

cards.situation: Chcesz zacząć regularnie ćwiczyć. Zastanawiasz się, jaka forma aktywności będzie dla Ciebie najlepsza.
options: A teenager running in a park early in the morning.
Friends playing basketball together on an outdoor court after school.
A young person swimming lengths alone in a quiet indoor pool.
criteria: Wybierz aktywność, która najbardziej Ci odpowiada, i uzasadnij wybór.
Wyjaśnij, dlaczego nie wybierasz pozostałych.
questions: Why do some young people not do any sport?
Tell me about a time when you tried a new sport or activity.

cards.situation: Po ciężkim tygodniu egzaminów chcesz dobrze odpocząć. Wybierasz sposób relaksu na weekend.
options: A girl sleeping late and reading a book in bed.
A boy doing yoga on a mat in a quiet room with soft music.
Friends having a picnic on the grass by a calm lake.
criteria: Wybierz sposób odpoczynku, który najlepiej wpłynie na Twoje zdrowie, i uzasadnij wybór.
Wyjaśnij, dlaczego odrzucasz pozostałe sposoby.
questions: Why is it important to take breaks from studying?
Do you think teenagers today have too much homework? Why?

cards.situation: Twoja rodzina chce wziąć zwierzę do domu. Musicie zdecydować, jakie będzie najlepsze.
options: A friendly dog that needs a long walk every day.
A cat sleeping on a sofa and playing with a toy.
A small tank with colourful fish on a shelf.
criteria: Wybierz zwierzę, które najlepiej pasuje do Waszej rodziny, i uzasadnij wybór.
Wyjaśnij, dlaczego pozostałe zwierzęta są mniej odpowiednie.
questions: Why do many people like having pets?
What can ordinary people do to protect wild animals?

cards.situation: Twoja szkoła organizuje akcję charytatywną. Uczniowie głosują, w jaki sposób pomóc potrzebującym.
options: Students collecting warm clothes and toys in big boxes.
A school concert where tickets are sold for charity.
Teenagers visiting elderly people in a care home.
criteria: Wybierz akcję, która przyniesie największą korzyść, i uzasadnij wybór.
Wyjaśnij, dlaczego pozostałe pomysły są mniej skuteczne.
questions: Why is it important for young people to help others?
Tell me about a time when you helped someone.
